items.description: Whitelist restrictions allow the contract to restrict users' transactions by excluding their address from the whitelist.
Cooling-off period means that users may not be able to buy or sell the token in a certain period of time.
Blacklist restrictions allow the contract to restrict users' transactions by blacklisting their addresses.
According to the token rules, trading may be paused via smart contracts, preventing on-chain buys or sells.
Selling restrictions mean that users may be restricted from selling all their tokens at once.
Anti-whale mechanism restricts the amount or frequency of transactions to prevent large sells and may affect large traders.
Contract ownership not renounced means the creator still retains control and may alter parameters such as buy-sell taxes or blacklists, potentially leading to user asset losses.
Self-destruct function means the token contract can be destroyed, which will result in your token holdings being erased.
Mintable function means token total supply can be increased, which may affect token price.
Balance manipulation was found, which means developers can transfer funds without approval to manipulate user balance.
The token was deployed by a high-risk address, which may be associated with fraud, exploits, or other malicious activities.
This token is associated with hacking incident, hackers may gain control over this contract.
Upgradeable contract means the token contract can potentially change rules and may introduce malicious functions.
Modified tax means tax rate can be changed and may affect the cost to the user when buying and selling.
Such accounts means your tokens may be frozen, resulting in potential asset loss.
A honeypot is a token that can be bought but not sold, and users will suffer asset losses after buying it.
Gas abuse refers to abnormal gas fee mechanisms that result in users paying excessive fee.
Unusual buy tax means users will pay a high tax and receive fewer tokens when buying.
Unusual sell tax means users will pay a high tax and receive fewer tokens when selling.
Low liquidity means that there is no or a small liquidity pool, resulting in failure to swap or large slippage.
Rug pull means that relevant funds may be withdrawn suddenly, leaving users with worthless tokens.
Abnormal airdrops indicate that the token has experienced abnormal airdrops of low-value distributions, which may result in potentially misleading market signals.
Wash trade refers to artificially inflated trading volumes, making the data fail to show true market demand.
Contract code verification checks if the contract has been reviewed and matches the deployed version on the blockchain, reflecting the project's transparency.
